definitions.gloss: to read and understand, to interpret
definitions.explanation: To comprehend the meaning, intention, or implication behind written text or a situation.
To use a device to read barcodes, QR codes, or other machine-readable data.

notes:
{読|よ}み{取|と}る is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) meaning to read and comprehend or to scan.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read) + ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take) → to take in what one reads

ASPECT (ている):
{読|よ}み{取|と}っている indicates an ongoing process of interpreting or scanning.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{意図|いと}→意図：12625_ito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{取|と}る (read someone's intention)
- ⟦{行間|ぎょうかん}→行間：07324_gyoukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{取|と}る (read between the lines)
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{取|と}る (read the room/atmosphere)
- ⟦バーコード→バーコード：10282_baakoodo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{取|と}る (scan a barcode)
- ⟦QRコード→QRコード：06403_kyuuaarukoodo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{取|と}る (scan a QR code)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}り→読み取り：08714_yomitori⟧: reading, scanning; 読み取り機 = scanner

TECHNICAL USAGE:
In the digital context, {読|よ}み{取|と}る is the standard verb for scanning barcodes, QR codes, IC cards, etc.
